$comment: Parameters of the space-graph generator (space-graph.generator.ts). The node's frame sets the circle: centre = frame centre, radius = half the shorter side. CHANGED from the studio draft: `x-binding` sits on the `readers` array itself rather than on its `items`, because `bindingsOf` (react-ui-canvas generator/runner.ts) reads the property and never looks inside it.

pitch.description: Distance between neighbouring lattice points (scene units).

fill.description: Share of lattice points that become objects.

extra.description: Chance each other pair of neighbouring objects is linked.

readers.description: Cards that read and write this space; each gets links to `picks` nodes, which light up.
